text:
Cutter Gauthier has goals in five straight games, ten of them in that run, and a seven-game point streak; NHL.com says his goal and power-play streaks are making Ducks history. He has 12 goals in 16 games, 12 power-play points, and the Flyers' decision to trade the fifth overall pick of 2022 to Anaheim in January 2024 looks worse every week.

Part of this is real. He is playing 18:18 a night, he is on the ice for 87 percent of Anaheim's power-play chances (55 percent last season), and his own chances are up to 1.52 expected goals per 60. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had him at 8.6 scoring chances per 60 from the home-plate area last season, 99th percentile among forwards. He goes where goals come from.

Part of it is not. He is shooting 18 percent on 12 goals from 7.4 expected, and Anaheim's five-on-five chance share with him on the ice is 41 percent, which means the power play is carrying a lot. Our projection still lands near 50 goals because the volume is there: 66 shots in 16 games. Watch the even-strength chances; if they climb, the hot streak becomes a season.
headline: Gauthier is scoring like a 50-goal man, for now
